g.aria-label: X-axis titled 'displ' for a linear scale with values from 2 to 7
Y-axis titled 'hwy' for a linear scale with values from 10 to 45
X-axis titled 'class' for a discrete scale with 7 values: 2seater, compact, midsize, minivan, pickup, subcompact, suv
Y-axis titled 'count' for a linear scale with values from 0 to 65
Symbol legend titled 'drv' for fill color with 3 values: f, 4, r
